gitCommit.subject: release proof (4th revision): retire output-level behaviour claims; L1 config + L2 inlining + L3 real-browser OFF run with accepted ON control, judged by a gate
gitCommit.body:
release proof (4th revision): retire output-level behaviour claims; L1 config + L2 inlining + L3 real-browser OFF run with accepted ON control, judged by a gate

Why: four independent reviews (c9d49dd, 905b1d4, d14aa7b, cab8cab) each defeated the static model of
the shipped handler with constructs the engine evaluates and the model did not (functional updaters,
valueOf coercion, accessor refs, poison.call(globalThis), aliased Reflect, tampered require, outer
finally, duplicate onClick, synthesised ON predicate). Handler inertness over arbitrary compiled JS is
not decidable by a whitelist; every exemption widened the accepted language. This revision makes no
behavioural claim from minified output.

Contract: resolve (effective flag exactly "false" from a committed file, CRA loader agrees; refuse to
build otherwise) + canary (single string-literal coachcore:import-config=false token in the shipped entry
chunks; source reads the flag only at the release boundary with the accepted guards verbatim) + gate
(real-browser RP-OFF-01/02/03 on the same-commit import-OFF emulator build and the accepted D10-01/D10-02
on the opted-in build must all have executed and passed; skips/flaky/missing are inconclusive).

- scripts/security/release-import-config.js: resolve/canary/gate; scan and negative-control removed.
- scripts/security/release-import-config.test.mjs: 65 checks; all 23 false-OFF and 2 false-ON fixtures
  from the four reviews kept (reviewers' actual-behaviour harness + real React 19/jsdom updater), the
  superseded scanners' false verdicts reproduced from git (explicit SKIP when history is shallow), gate
  fail-closed cases, real-build cases.
- scripts/security/verify-release-build.sh: L1+L2 only (19 PASS lines), RESULT line says so; retains
  release-canary.json, import-off build manifest, toolchain versions in release-build.context.
- e2e: build-app.sh E2E_IMPORT_OFF=1 mode; playwright.release-proof.config.ts (two builds served side by
  side; chromium+firefox); tests/release-import-off.spec.ts; main config testIgnore keeps 182 tests.
- workflow: import-OFF build, L3 run and gate in desktop acceptance jobs; explicit "no claim" notice
  elsewhere.
- docs/security/RELEASE_PROOF_IMPORT_OFF_2026-10-18.md: root cause, contract, establishes/assumptions,
  proposed (not implemented) structural release boundary refactor.
Application code, support drafts, B11 suite membership and settings unchanged. No merge/deploy; MVP NO-GO.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01YHR8pnKSDwARt3y7Ay5ru3
